from.context: Label for the sender identity selector in the compose form

to.context: Label for the recipient field in the compose form

new_message.context: Button for composing a new message in sidebar

sending.context: Indicates that the message is currently being sent

title.context: Title of the alert shown when the user tries to send a message without any recipients

content.string: Please add at least one recipient before sending.
content.context: Content of the alert shown when the user tries to send a message without any recipients

ok.context: Label for the OK button in the alert

no_recipient_alert.context: Alert shown when the user tries to send a message without any recipients

schedule_sending.context: Schedule the sending of the composed message

save_draft.context: Save the composed message as a draft

restore.context: Restore the compose window to its previous size

open_in_new_page.context: Open the compose window in a new page

jitsi.context: Button to insert a Jitsi video meeting link into the message body

max_recipients_reached.context: Error shown when the maximum number of recipients has been reached

max_windows_error.context: Error shown when the user tries to open more than three floating compose windows

signature.context: Label for the signature picker button in the compose header

no_signature.context: Label for the option to have no signature in the signature picker

attachment.context: Button to insert an attachment into the message body

return_receipt.context: Button to request a return receipt for the email

priority.context: Button to set the priority of the email

low.context: Option to set the email priority to low

lowest.context: Option to set the email priority to lowest

normal.context: Option to set the email priority to normal

high.context: Option to set the email priority to high

highest.context: Option to set the email priority to highest

attachment_error.context: Error message shown when an attachment fails to upload

drop_files.context: Overlay message shown when the user drags files over the compose window

attachment_upload.context: Message shown while an attachment is being uploaded

loading.context: Loading state while searching contacts and users

add_direct.context: Add a typed email address directly as recipient
